title: Explicit tracks
statementMd:
How many tracks are marked explicit?

Expected columns: `explicit_tracks`.

Tables: `artists`, `albums`, `tracks`, `listeners`, `plays`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS explicit_tracks FROM tracks WHERE explicit = 1;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
